title: ‘Rich Dad, Poor Lad’: How do Large Language Models Contextualize Socioeconomic Factors in College Admission ?

bias_targets.methodology: Generating a synthetic dataset of college applicant profiles with varying socioeconomic indicators (e.g., first-generation status, fee waiver eligibility, ZIP code, school type) and academic metrics, then prompting LLMs for admission decisions under both fast (decision-only) and deliberative (Chain-of-Thought) settings. The evaluation analyzes conditional admission rates using mixed-effects models and evaluates the generated reasoning to see how socioeconomic factors are used to support, penalize, or compensate for academic performance.
